import numpy as np
from portfolio_baseline import generate_test_data, portfolio_risk_python, portfolio_return_python
from portfolio_optimized import portfolio_risk_c, portfolio_return_c

# empty list case
assert portfolio_risk_c([], []) == 0.0
assert portfolio_return_c([], []) == 0.0

for n in (1, 2, 10, 257):
    w, cov, r = generate_test_data(n)
    expected_ret = portfolio_return_python(w, r)
    expected_risk = portfolio_risk_python(w, cov)
    cases = [
        (w, cov, r),
        (tuple(w), tuple(tuple(row) for row in cov), tuple(r)),
        (np.array(w), np.array(cov), np.array(r)),
        (np.array(w), np.asfortranarray(np.array(cov)), np.array(r)),
    ]
    if n > 2:
        big_w = np.repeat(np.array(w), 2)[::2]
        big_cov = np.repeat(np.repeat(np.array(cov), 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)[::2, ::2]
        big_r = np.repeat(np.array(r), 2)[::2]
        cases.append((big_w, big_cov, big_r))
    for ww, cc, rr in cases:
        rk = portfolio_risk_c(ww, cc)
        rt = portfolio_return_c(ww, rr)
        assert abs(rk - expected_risk) < 1e-10, (n, rk, expected_risk)
        assert abs(rt - expected_ret) < 1e-10, (n, rt, expected_ret)
print("edge / array input tests passed")
